article.story: RIVERDALE, N.Y. -- — Devin Dinkins had 22 points in Manhattan's 95-90 win over Rider on Friday night. Dinkins shot 5 of 9 from the field, including 4 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 8 from the line for the Jaspers (9-14, 5-7 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Terrance Jones scored 18 points while shooting 7 for 13, including 3 for 9 from beyond the arc and added five rebounds. Jaden Winston shot 4 of 11 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 7 from the line to finish with 16 points. Zion Cruz finished with 22 points, four assists and two steals for the Broncs (2-18, 1-10). Caleb Smith added 18 points and seven rebounds for Rider. Aasim Burton had 15 points, 11 assists and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
